note: Profile limits the brand pack writes to. Only numbers a platform publishes are stored; where a platform does not publish one, limit is null, we write to a shorter target and tell the member to check the counter in the app.

instagram.label: Instagram
instagram.rule: Your bio can be up to 150 characters.

tiktok.label: TikTok
tiktok.rule: TikTok does not publish its bio limit on its help pages. We keep it to 80 characters; check the counter in the app before you save.

facebook.label: Facebook Page
facebook.rule: Facebook's help pages do not state the Page intro limit. We keep it to 100 characters; check the counter when you edit the intro.
